privacy_detector_regressions.qualification: A bare letter-colon-backslash is insufficient evidence of a machine path; known filesystem directory context is required.

scope: All recognized textual members and PDF extracted text/raw string metadata; matched private values are hashed, never copied into this report.
packaging_rule: Exclude raw execution directories, compiler intermediates, raw stdout and caches. Retain only screened public compile logs and structured summaries.
